A.briefing: 環境二段の突破。入口の敵は任意の追加目標。成長・素材と札候補。

B.briefing: 目的敵の撃破。周囲への回避支援を持つ環境は先に踏破してもよい。成長・素材と札候補。

C.briefing: 通路踏破の先で目的敵を撃破。支援環境と消耗は後半へ続く。成長・素材と札候補。

limits: Conditions fixed before execution: 3 routes x 2 builds x 7 skill sets x 2 public policies x 8 seeds = 672 runs.
HP, aura, decks, deterministic rewards, skill effects and equal cost are trial inputs, not adopted product rules.
Learned skills are active; no separate equipment slots, ranks or prerequisites are introduced.
Initial skill budget is a controlled fixture, not a naturally earned growth curve. All matrix decks use initial unlocked cards.
A or B clear unlocks C after return in this trial. Knowledge of C and its actual playability are separate.
The weak replacement environment has an explicit HP floor of 1 and twice the action interval; it gives no repeat traversal reward.
Policies use current public choices and predictions, never future draws, opponent hands or authored hidden catalogues.
No automatic withdrawal policy in the matrix. Cutoff is censored, not defeat or voluntary withdrawal. Separate return checks cover withdrawal.
No tuning or seed selection on outcome. Both policies are simple probes, not optimal agents or human play.
